html.body: Date: 2025-04-14 REMARKSFavorable reconsideration of this Application, in light of the following discussion, is respectfully requested. Claims 15-28 were previously presented. New claim 29 has been added.Claim 26 has been canceled without prejudice or disclaimer. Accordingly, claims 15-25 and 27- 29 are pending in the present Application. Applicant submits that upon entry of the present Response, claims 15-25 and 27-29 are in condition for allowance. Moreover, the Applicant submits that no new matter has been introduced by the foregoing amendments.Allowable Subiect Matter The outstanding Office Action indicates that claims 15-25, 27, and 28 are allowed.Applicant acknowledges with appreciation the indication of allowable subject matter.Claim 26 has been canceled and rewritten as new claim 29, and Applicant respectfully submits that new claim 29 is allowable as explained below.Rejections under 35 U.S.C. §101 In the outstanding Office Action, claim 26 was rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 101, as allegedly being directed to non-statutory subject matter. In particular, the position of the Office Action is that claim 26, which described "A computer program comprising instructions...", did not have a physical form. Tt he Office Action kindly suggested that Applicant consider directing the claim to "A non-transitory computer readable medium having a computer program stored thereon comprising instructions..." to place the claimed invention within one of the statutory categories.Addressing now the rejections under 35 U.S.C. § 101, claim 26 has been canceled, and a new claim 29 has been added and written in manner consistent with the kind suggestion in the Office Action. Specifically, the new claim describes a non-transitory computer readable medium comprising instructions for the implementation of the steps of a method according to claim 15 when the instructions are executed by a computer, as described, for example, in the first paragraph of page 7 of the specification as filed.Therefore, for at least the foregoing reasons, Applicant respectfully submits that claim 29 is directed toward patent-eligible subject matter. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests that the rejection under 35 U.S.C. § 101 be withdrawn.Furthermore, as new claim 29 concerns a non-transitory computer readable medium comprising instructions for the implementation of the steps of a method according to claim 15, and claim 15 was considered to be new and non-obvious, subject-matter of new claim 29 should also be patentable.CONCLUSIONConsequently, in view of the present amendment and in light of the above discussion, the outstanding grounds of rejection are believed to have been overcome. The Application, as amended, is believed to be in condition of allowance. An early and favorable action to that effect is respectfully requested.Respectfully submitted, /Robert A.
